title: Summoning Rite Behavior Contract
description: Authoritative contract for the shell bootstrap, Python dispatcher, shared install engine, and the agent-legible state surface.

modes.label: Shell bootstrap
required_behaviors: Find Python 3.10+ (python3, python, or the Windows py launcher), installing it only with explicit user consent.
Download summon.py, summon_core.py, the agent-target registry, and the Grimoire routing block template when run from the public one-liner; a local checkout uses its own files.
Retry companion downloads with curl or wget, then fall back to a Python urllib download.
Pass command-line arguments through to the Python dispatcher.

modes.label: Python dispatcher
required_behaviors: Run the terminal installer.
Route --check, --reconcile, and --update to the state surface when summon_state is available.
Run the installer path when summon_state is absent (piped bootstrap).

modes.label: Python CLI
required_behaviors: Check git before install work.
Install or update Arcana.
Optionally discover GitHub/GitLab grimoires from a scope URL.
Optionally clone selected grimoires.
Update the local library for installed grimoires.
Inject supported agent routing blocks.
Register Arcana and grimoire skills.
Report completion, warnings, and update instructions.

modes.label: Agent-legible state surface
required_behaviors: Report installation and registry drift read-only via --check, exiting 1 when drift is found.
Emit the shared ResultReporter envelope under --format json or jsonl.
Write a durable transcript to ~/.cache/grimoire/summon-last.json for install, check, and reconcile operations.
Reconcile the local library additively under --reconcile --apply, preserving stale entries unless --prune is given.
Sync skills under --reconcile/--update --apply via sync_skills.py --reset-managed.
Refuse to reconcile when the Arcana base fails validate.py.

Detect agent routing blocks by their BEGIN/END markers only; under --reconcile/--update --apply, create an absent file, insert into a block-less file, and refresh one clean marked region in place, leaving any block-like-but-not-clean file (duplicate or malformed markers, or a pre-marker heading-only block) for the /grm-update agentfile judgment edit.
Exclude network pull of Arcana itself as a human-gated update step.

Under --update, pull every library grimoire branch-aware (fetch, then fast-forward only a clean branch that is behind), heal only the grimoires confirmed current, collect unreachable/dirty/diverged grimoires into needs_manual_pull, and never abort the run on a per-grimoire auth or offline failure.

required_pipeline.label: Discover grimoires from a git host scope

bootstrap_environment.name: ARCANA_REF
bootstrap_environment.purpose: Override the raw-source ref for companion script downloads.

bootstrap_environment.name: GRIMOIRE_SUMMON_DOWNLOAD_ATTEMPTS
bootstrap_environment.purpose: Set the companion-script download retry count.

bootstrap_environment.name: GRIMOIRE_SUMMON_RETRY_DELAY
bootstrap_environment.purpose: Set the delay (seconds) between download attempts.

bootstrap_environment.name: GRIMOIRE_SUMMON_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
bootstrap_environment.purpose: Set the connection timeout (seconds) for downloads.

parity_checks.contract: The terminal install path and the --reconcile/--update state surface both perform local library update, agent block injection, and skill registration through summon_core primitives.
The piped shell bootstrap fetches exactly the companion files the dispatcher needs (summon.py, summon_core.py, agent_targets.py, data/agent_targets.json, templates/grimoire_block.md).
